recognize_zh: 一個大小約和紅血球差不多的圓形細胞，核佔幾乎整個細胞、染色質濃縮成塊，只剩一圈很薄的藍色胞質、沒有顆粒，這是正常小型成熟淋巴球。
features: Small round cell approximately the size of a red cell
Round nucleus with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin; no visible nucleoli
Scant thin rim of blue agranular cytoplasm
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small mature lymphocyte approximately the size of an adjacent red cell, with a round nucleus, dense clumped chromatin, no visible nucleoli and a scant rim of agranular blue cytoplasm. Surrounding red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a normal small mature lymphocyte.

ddx.vs: LGLs are larger with moderate pale cytoplasm containing azurophilic granules.
CLL cells look similar individually but show soccer-ball chromatin, smudge cells and an absolute lymphocytosis on the whole smear.
Orthochromatic normoblasts have a pyknotic, very dark nucleus with pink-orange hemoglobinized cytoplasm.
